Welcome to UNC Charlotte

UNC Charlotte is North Carolina's urban research university in Charlotte, NC. Students at UNCC cheer for the Charlotte 49ers. Charlotte is also the largest city in the state. {{WORDS:200}}

Research

UNC Charlotte researchers work across Charlotte, NC and beyond. The Charlotte 49ers compete in Division I. UNCC is a member of the UNC System. {{WORDS:80}}
